v2.subtitle: Advanced search is a small query language. Use field tokens and operators to narrow requests.

basics.title: Basics (how queries are parsed)
basics.intro: Write conditions as field:value or field=value. Use commas for AND inside a group, and | to create OR groups.

fields.title: Request fields
fields.intro: These fields match request data. Use : for partial match and = for exact match. IDs are always exact.

examples.level: #123 or level=123 finds requests for that level. id=45 finds a specific request.
examples.requesterStatus:
requester:v0w4n, status:pending
Filter by username or nickname and status.
examples.typeReason:
type:info, reason:offset
Type is most useful on My requests, where all types are listed together.

tips.title: Tips
tips.intro: A few details that help avoid surprises.

bullets.plainText: A term without a field still searches song, artist, level id, request id, requester, status, reason, and (on My requests) type.
bullets.statusToggle: Choosing a status in Filter, or using status: in the query, ignores the completed toggle.
bullets.caseInsensitive: Search is case-insensitive: 'SONG' and 'song' behave the same.
bullets.spacesAllowed: Spaces are allowed in values: song:Example Song works.
bullets.groupingMentalModel: Think of it as (A AND B) OR (C AND D): commas build AND groups, | splits OR groups.

operatorColon.title: Partial match
operatorColon.desc: Use : to match partial text (example: song:go).

operatorComma.title: AND inside a group
operatorComma.desc: Separate terms with commas to require all conditions in the group.

operatorPipe.title: OR between groups
operatorPipe.desc: Use | to split your query into OR groups. If any group matches, the request is included.

operatorNot.title: NOT (exclude)
operatorNot.desc: Prefix a term with \! to exclude matches containing that term.

level.title: Level id
level.desc: Exact level id. levelId is an alias (example: level:123).

requester.title: Requester
requester.desc: Matches username or nickname. user and username are aliases.

status.title: Status
status.desc: pending, accepted, added_to_rating_page (aliases: rating, rating_page), discord_vote (aliases: discord, vote), rejected, withdrawn, completed, completed_changed, completed_unchanged.

type.title: Request type
type.desc: rerate, info_change (alias: info), tag, curation, curation_rerate. Most useful on My requests.

list.statusIgnoresCompleted: Completed is ignored while a status is selected or the search uses status:.
